ruleDefinitions.name: ETW Logging/Processing Option Disabled On IIS Server
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects changes to of the IIS server configuration in order to disable/remove the ETW logging/processing option. Note: Unmapped fields: Configuration, OldValue, NewValue

sequences.query: (event_id = 29 AND Configuration = RGX("\\@logTargetW3C$") AND OldValue = RGX(".*ETW.*")) AND  NOT (NewValue = RGX(".*ETW.*"))
